name: Wisconsin
feeText: Commencing a family action (divorce, annulment, legal separation) with no request for support or maintenance: $184.50 ($75 filing fee, $68 CSS, $21.50 JINFO, $20 family court counseling services fee) (Wis. Stat. § 814.61(1)(a)-(b)); $194.50 with a request for support or maintenance (extra $10 under § 814.61(13)). Wisconsin Circuit Court Fee Tables updated November 14, 2024.

otherFees.what: Family action with a request for support or maintenance (§ 814.61(1)(b), (13))
E-filing fee per party when the case is electronically filed (§ 758.19(4m), 801.18(7))
Post-judgment motion in a family action (§ 814.61(7)(a))

waiver.name: Petition for waiver of fees and costs (Wis. Stat. § 814.29(1))

residency.text: One party must have been a bona fide resident of Wisconsin for at least 6 months and of the county of filing for at least 30 days before commencing a divorce (Wis. Stat. § 767.301).

waitingPeriod.text: A divorce may not be brought to final hearing or trial until 120 days after service of the summons and petition on the respondent, or 120 days after filing a joint petition, unless the court orders an immediate hearing for an emergency (Wis. Stat. § 767.335).

simplified.text: No summary dissolution procedure; spouses may file a joint petition, which starts the 120-day waiting period on the filing date (Wis. Stat. § 767.335(1)).

parentingClass.text: No statewide mandate in statute: in an action affecting the family with a minor child, the court may order the parties to attend a program (up to 4 hours) on the effects of dissolution on children (Wis. Stat. § 767.401(1)); counties may require it by local rule.
